articles.title: Redington shares rally 15% after Q1 profit surges 77%; revenue rises 35% YoY

articles.title: Global Market: BOJ may shift to inflation-fighting mode by December, says former official Watanabe
articles.content: The Bank of Japan could switch to an aggressive inflation-fighting stance as early as December 2026, accelerating interest rate hikes to quarterly intervals, according to former BOJ official Tsutomu Watanabe. Rising underlying inflation and wage growth may force the central bank to abandon its current policy tolerance.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Trump backs Warsh as Fed’s hawkish tilt raises rate hike odds
articles.content: President Trump supports Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh despite policy disagreements. Warsh maintains a cautious stance on monetary easing, differing from Trump's calls. The central bank kept interest rates unchanged at its latest policy meeting. Some Federal Open Market Committee members favored a rate increase due to inflation concerns. Financial markets now anticipate a potential rate hike at the upcoming September meeting.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Warsh faces early Fed dissent as three policymakers push for rate hike
articles.content: New Federal Reserve chair Kevin Warsh faces significant early policy disagreements. Three members opposed the central bank's decision to keep interest rates unchanged. This level of dissent is historically uncommon for a new Fed chair. Previous leaders like Janet Yellen and Jerome Powell experienced less initial opposition. These divisions suggest ongoing debates about future interest rate paths.

articles.title: Odyssey of stock market: What investors can learn from the Greek epic hero’s journey back home?
articles.content: Investors can learn from Odysseus's long voyage home.  Resisting temptations and instant profits are crucial for long-term success.  True value in stocks is revealed over extended periods of time.  Stagnation in risk-free assets hinders portfolio growth and ultimate goals.  Patience and adaptability are key for survival and achieving investment objectives.

articles.title: $32 billion inflows from India's forex drive yet to boost rupee
articles.content: India's special measures have attracted $32 billion in foreign currency inflows, but the boost has yet to significantly strengthen the rupee or ease banking system liquidity. While borrowing costs have declined, the RBI's foreign currency assets have risen more slowly as markets await the full impact of the inflows.

articles.title: Hated till June, hottest in July! What’s driving the Rs 3.8 lakh crore boom in IT stocks?
articles.content: Indian IT stocks saw a remarkable July rally, adding significant market value and reversing investor pessimism. This surge was largely driven by short sellers closing bearish positions and reassessing AI disruption concerns. Several major IT companies experienced substantial gains, contributing to the sector's overall market capitalization increase. Investors are now questioning if this rebound signals a lasting rerating or a temporary tactical rally.
